records.name: CHEST TOMB APPROXIMATELY 12 METRES SOUTH OF SOUTH AISLE OF CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST
records.officialName: Chest Tomb Approximately 12 Metres South of South Aisle of Church of St John the Baptist
records.details:
CORBY CHURCH WALK SP8988NE (East side) 18/10 Chest tomb approx. 12m. S of S aisle of Church of St. John the Baptist

GV II

Chest tomb. C16/C17. Limestone ashlar. 3 quatrefoil panels with shields to each side and one to each end. Chamfered and ribbed slab over. No inscription.

Listing NGR: SP8983288751

records.name: 79 AND 81, HIGH STREET
records.details:
SP8988NE 

18/14 

17/03/53

CORBY 

HIGH STREET

(North side)

Nos.79 and 81

GV II

Pair of houses. Early C19. Regular coursed limestone with Collyweston slate

roofs. Originally 2-unit terrace plans. 2 storeys. Together comprising a

4-window range of C20 casements in original openings under shallow stone arches.

C20 doors to far left and right under similar heads, one has rustic porch.

Hipped roof with central stone stack; single-storey extension to rear. Interiors

not inspected. Included for group value.

Listing NGR: SP8966088954

records.name: GATEPIER ADJACENT TO NUMBER 83 (THE OLD SCHOOL HOUSE)
records.officialName: Gatepier Adjacent to Number 83 (The Old School House)
records.details:
CORBY HIGH STREET SP8988NE (North side) 18/16 Gatepier adjacent to No.83 (The Old School House)

GV II

Gatepier. Late C18. Limestone ashlar pier with ball finial. Forms pair with gatepier approximately 3 metres east of No.83 (The Old School House) (q.v.). Included for group value.

Listing NGR: SP8968888941

records.name: 75 AND 77, HIGH STREET
records.details:
CORBY HIGH STREET SP8988NE (North side) 18/13 Nos.75 and 77 17/03/53

GV II

House, now office. Datestone 1609/RA. Regular coursed limestone with thatch roof. 3-unit plan. Originally 2 storeys. 3-window range of part leaded casements under wood lintels. First floor centre window has moulded stone surround set in stone eaves dormer. C20 panelled door to left of centre under wood lintel. Ashlar gable parapets and kneelers and ashlar stacks, one with moulded cornice; at ridge and end. Datestone in apex of dormer. Interior remodelled C20.

Listing NGR: SP8964388951
